purpose: Teach: 有能/異例/セクター/ワイド/賞金/物品/非常勤/マネジャー

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、有能な捜査官を配置しております
lines.en: We have deployed capable investigators to the case.
lines.style: Professional, measured opening. Even tone. No rush. The reassurance of competence stated plainly, without fanfare. Voice sits steady.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察の異例のスピード解決、ありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. We're grateful for how quickly the police moved on this.
lines.style: Respectful, earnest. A slight lean forward in the voice — genuine appreciation, not performance. Warm but formal. Careful not to overstate.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、民間セクターとも連携します
lines.en: We'll also be coordinating with the private sector on this investigation.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery. Each phrase lands evenly. No apology for the scope. Steady eye-contact level in the voice. Official but not distant.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、ワイドな捜査網、頼もしいです
lines.en: Yes. It's reassuring to see how wide the investigation net has become.
lines.style: Appreciative nod in the voice. Slow, careful phrasing. He's genuinely impressed. Tone stays grounded — not effusive, but sincere in the recognition.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、情報提供者に賞金制度を用意しております
lines.en: We've also put a reward system in place for anyone who comes forward with information.
lines.style: Procedural but not cold. Light emphasis on the incentive detail. Tempo steady. This is leverage presented as practical necessity, not desperation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、押収物品の管理も厳格ですね
lines.en: Yes. I can see the police are handling the seized evidence with real care too.
lines.style: Observant. He's noticed the detail. Small warmth in the acknowledgment — he sees them working. Not flattering, just honest recognition of discipline.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、非常勤の警備員も派遣しております
lines.en: We've also dispatched additional part-time security personnel to support the operation.
lines.style: Calm listing of resources. No strain in the delivery. Each detail adds weight to the picture of thoroughness. Voice remains composed, almost clinical.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察マネジャー職の方々、ご活躍ですね
lines.en: Yes. Your management team is really doing excellent work here.
lines.style: Warm closing. Direct acknowledgment of people, not just process. Slight easing in the pace — he means this. Genuine respect for the effort he's witnessed.
